text_block_list.text:
On the way to the academy studio for dance 
lessons with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi—
One! Two! Three! One-two, one-two!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, looking good! Nice! It's like... 
really coming together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I did it~...! M-Massive 
growth~...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. No, not at all! It's not 
like I'm evaluating their lesson. I'm just 
kind of cheering them on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tsurumaru-chan giving it her 
absolute all, I just couldn't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your guidance has been 
incredibly educational!

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was also highly 
motivated. Since it was a great 
opportunity, I decided to have the two of 
them take the lesson together today.
...However.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! If you're off-beat, 
cover it on the 'ta-ta'!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um... yes! Right at the 'rat-a-tat' part, 
right?!
choice_data_list:
(Their way of teaching is so rough around 
the edges...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop moving even if you mess up! 
Just, like... keep moving somehow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's really coming together! I think 
it looks great!

It's true that it's coming together, but 
there are many minor mistakes. Off-beat 
timing, missed steps... However...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! At this rate, I'm gonna keep 
getting better and better at dancing~!

"Reprimanding her and dampening her 
current motivation doesn't seem like the 
best move. Let's direct this enthusiasm 
toward the finer details."
choice_data_list:
If you improve your sense of rhythm, 
you'll get even better!
I'd like to see sharper steps.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A sense of rhythmâyou're right! Top 
Road-san! Please, try this one next!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Now then—grab some maracas! 
Let's ride all sorts of rhythms and train 
our ears!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Shake-shake! Shake-shake! 
Shake-shake-shake-shake!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! Just like that! I feel 
like... I'm really getting into the 
rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to harmonize with the 
sound! Let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Here I go! ...One-two! One-two!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, this feeling! I'm riding the rhythm!!

And so, she managed to get the hang of it. 
Perhaps taking a rough, casual approach 
every once in a while wasn't such a bad 
idea after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That's true! If your footwork is good, 
your whole dance looks way better!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Top Road-san, just a little 
further, please keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If it's footwork you want to 
practice... let's use this ball! First, 
try taking it from me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehh~?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... I can't get it at all... 
*pant* *pant*.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but watching the steps should have 
helped you get used to the movements. Now, 
let's try dancing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Here I go! ...One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I can move! It's like my body remembers! 
This is the footwork!!

And so, she managed to get the hang of it. 
Perhaps taking a rough, casual approach 
every once in a while wasn't such a bad 
idea after all.
